# meok-uas-commercial-drone-mcp

> Commercial drone / UAS compliance toolkit — UK CAA CAP 722, Open / Specific / Certified categories, A2 CofC + GVC + Operational Authorisation pilot competence, US FAA Part 107, EU 2019/947 + 2019/945, CAA SUA inspection prep. For Royal Mail, NHS drone logistics, Wing, Amazon Prime Air, Aerialscape. By MEOK AI Labs.

MCP server by MEOK AI Labs. Framework: fastmcp. Transport: stdio.

## Tools
- check_caa_operator_authorisation
- check_uas_open_category
- check_uas_specific_category
- check_uas_certified_category
- check_remote_pilot_competence
- check_far_part_107_us
- check_easa_uas_reg_2019_947
- prepare_caa_inspection_pack

## Install
```
pip install meok-uas-commercial-drone-mcp
```
